description: Rule-only normal FAR is high in the frozen INNER pilot so operational utility is not established.
mitigation: Treat D1 as pilot complementarity evidence and validate false-alarm control on broader data.

description: GDN candidate evidence exists but unique stable contribution beyond META and STAT is unvalidated.

description: Agentic feedback benefit is unvalidated because T2 activated zero feedback-repair actions.
mitigation: Design a budget-matched cohort that can exercise feedback.

description: D2 V1 and V2 recovered none of the three D0-missed pilot events and do not support improvement.
mitigation: Keep the negative pilot frozen and preregister any future fusion design.

description: Held-out generalization is unavailable because no OUTER scientific result exists.
mitigation: Require new explicit authorization and preregistration before held-out evaluation.

description: Fresh-machine reproducibility is incomplete despite strong public traceability.
mitigation: Build and independently rehearse a sanitized fresh-machine capsule.

description: The current detector reference is PCA-SPE and expanded validation lacks a stronger multivariate baseline.
mitigation: Seek approval for at least one preregistered stronger multivariate baseline.

description: Automated trace grounding does not establish human explanation usefulness.
mitigation: Scope claims to trace grounding unless a human evaluation is approved.

description: Stale continuity and historical checkout context can be mistaken for current scientific authority.

description: Generic split-role contracts and frozen task-specific readers enforce compatible boundaries through distributed code rather than one proven universal adapter.

description: Future validation lacks one formally selected Rule verifier and runtime authority across canonical RuleV1 and the executed V4 path.
